title: Keep unsupported definition states explicit
preconditions: Use separate copies of a valid accepted-criterion fixture with each policy-required kind mapped by proposed or active cases.

steps.action: In separate copies introduce inactive definitions, invalid links, conflicting definition or relation heads, disallowed automation and stale mappings. Inspect Quality for each copy.
steps.expected_result: Only current proposed/active definitions with allowed automation and current mappings cover every required kind; each invalid/inactive/conflicted/disallowed/stale state remains an explicit gap, without an execution verdict.
